# fortiappseccloud_waf_template_api_gateway

Configures API gateway for one FortiAppSec Cloud WAF template using the static template endpoint `/waf/template/{template_id}/api_gateway`. This resource owns the template's module settings. To make an application inherit them, configure the matching app module resource with `template = true` and omit its `configs` block.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_api_gateway` resource for a WAF template.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_template_api_gateway" "example" {
  template_id = fortiappseccloud_waf_template.example.template_id

  configs {
    status = true
    action = "alert_deny"

    rule_list {
      item {
        name              = "example-rule"
        api_key_verify    = true
        api_key_loc       = "http-header"
        field_name        = "X-API-Key"
        rate_limit_period = 60
        rate_limit_req    = 100

        url_list {
          item {
            frontend = "/api"
            backend  = "/backend"
          }
        }

        user_list {
          item {
            user = "example-user"
          }
        }
      }
    }

    user_list {
      item {
        name     = "example-user"
        email    = "user@example.com"
        comments = "example user"

        ip_list {
          item {
            ip = "10.0.0.1"
          }
        }

        referer_list {
          item {
            referer = "example.com"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Configuration Notes

- Set `api_key_verify = true` before configuring `api_key_loc` and `field_name`. The example enables all three together and gives referenced users matching entries in `user_list`.

## Argument Reference

- `template_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — WAF template ID.
- `configs` (Required) — Typed API gateway configuration. Its attributes and ownership-wrapper blocks are identical to `fortiappseccloud_waf_api_gateway` when that app resource uses `template = false`.

## Import

Import using the template ID:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_template_api_gateway.example TEMPLATE_ID
```

The first read after import hydrates all supported ownership wrappers.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
